cost.scope: Backend total loaded texture/buffer/video allocations, plus all live scene geometry including hidden resource stages, LODs and MultiMesh references. Buffer totals include caches and non-geometry renderer buffers; triangle count is unique live-scene base meshes, not multiplied by instances.
